dish.title: Thai Crispy Barramundi with Three-Flavor Tamarind Sauce
dish.description: Barramundi pieces dredged in rice flour and cornstarch and deep-fried until shatteringly crisp, then spooned with a Thai three-flavor sauce (sweet, sour, and spicy) of tamarind, palm or brown sugar, fish sauce, garlic, shallots, and chiles. Served with jasmine rice and cucumber.

recipe_version.title: Thai Crispy Barramundi with Three-Flavor Tamarind Sauce
recipe_version.description: Barramundi pieces dredged in rice flour and cornstarch and deep-fried until shatteringly crisp, then spooned with a Thai three-flavor sauce (sweet, sour, and spicy) of tamarind, palm or brown sugar, fish sauce, garlic, shallots, and chiles. Served with jasmine rice and cucumber.

ingredients.name: barramundi fillets

ingredients.name: fish sauce
ingredients.display_name: fish sauce (anchovy and salt; label lists no shrimp or shellfish)

steps.title: Prep
steps.body: Rinse the rice. Cut the fish into 2-inch pieces and pat very dry. Slice the shallots and chiles, mince the garlic, slice the cucumber, and cut the limes into wedges. Whisk the rice flour, cornstarch, and salt in a wide bowl.

steps.title: Start the rice
steps.body: Combine the rice and 2 cups water in a 2-quart saucepan, bring to a boil over high heat, cover, turn to low, and cook 15 minutes; then rest covered off the heat 5 minutes. This runs inside steps 3 to 5 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Make the sauce and heat the oil
steps.body: Pour the 6 cups oil into a 5-quart Dutch oven (no more than half full), clip on a thermometer, and heat over medium-high to 350 F; it takes roughly the whole step to get there. Meanwhile, heat 1 tbsp oil in a 1-quart saucepan over medium and cook the shallots, garlic, and chiles until fragrant and lightly golden, about 3 minutes. Add the tamarind, sugar, fish sauce, and 1/4 cup water and simmer until glossy and syrupy, about 4 minutes.

steps.title: Deep-fry the fish
steps.body: Toss the fish in the coating and shake off the excess. Deep-fry in 3 batches, keeping the oil between 340 F and 360 F, until deep golden and crisp and the fish reads 145 F, about 4 minutes per batch. Drain on the rack.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Fluff the rice. Pile the fish on a platter, spoon the warm sauce over it, and scatter cilantro. Serve with the rice, cucumber, and lime wedges. Let the oil cool completely before discarding.

equipment: wire rack set over a sheet pan
